job.Name: Warrior

job.Description: An attacker that requires no support to perform at maximum efficiency.

job.Description: A pure attacker. Deals very high damage when circumstances are ideal. Wears medium armor.

job.Name: Beastmaster
job.Description: An attacker with unique abilities and the potential to deal lots of damage.

General.OPTION_EffectVolume_DESC: Adjust the volume of sound effects.
General.OPTION_MusicVolume_DESC: Adjust the volume of background music.
General.OPTION_WeatherVolume_DESC: Adjust the volume of weather sounds, such as rain and wind.
General.OPTION_Font_DESC_Pixel: Pixel: Matches the pixelated aesthetic of other parts of the game.
General.OPTION_Font_DESC_Smooth: Smooth: May be easier on the eyes to read.
General.OPTION_ShowMinimap_DESC_On: On: Shows the minimap. Note that the minimap will still only be visible while in areas for which you have found a map.
General.OPTION_AutoSave_DESC: Enable or disable automatic saving into the Auto Save slot.
General.OPTION_AutoSave_DESC_On: On: The game will periodically Auto Save.
General.OPTION_AutoSave_DESC_Off: Off: The game will not Auto Save. Can be useful if Auto Saving causes a stutter.
General.OPTION_BattleCursor_DESC: Set the default placement of the cursor during battle.
General.OPTION_BattleCursor_DESC_Reset: Reset: Places the cursor at the top of menus.
General.OPTION_BattleCursor_DESC_Memory: Memory: Places the cursor on previous selections.
General.OPTION_ConfirmHomePoint_DESC: Enable or disable the reminder to set your @V.HomePoint when saving.
General.OPTION_ConfirmHomePoint_DESC_On: On: A popup will prompt you to set the @V.HomePoint when saving at a @V.HomePoint that is not already set.
General.OPTION_ConfirmHomePoint_DESC_Off: Off: There will be no popup. The @V.HomePoint must be set explicitly instead.
General.OPTION_ReorderAbilities_DESC: Choose how abilities are ordered during battle.
General.OPTION_ReorderAbilities_DESC_On: On: Moves unusable abilities to the bottom of their ability lists.
General.OPTION_EnableAutoTopUp_DESC: Enable or disable the Auto Top Up option in the @V.Consumables menu.
General.OPTION_EnableAutoTopUp_DESC_On: On: The Auto Top Up option appears at the top of the @V.Consumables menu.
General.OPTION_EnableAutoTopUp_DESC_Off: Off: The Auto Top Up option is hidden.
General.OPTION_EnableAutoJump_DESC_On: On: Automatically jump at the last possible moment when walking off cliffs or ledges.
General.OPTION_EnableAutoJump_DESC_Off: Off: Walk off cliffs and ledges like normal.
General.OPTION_ProfanityFilter_DESC: Enable or disable the profanity filter.
General.OPTION_ProfanityFilter_DESC_On: On: Improper language is replaced with symbols and some monster sprites are censored.
General.OPTION_MinimapLocation_DESC: Place the minimap either on the left side or the right side of the screen.
General.OPTION_MinimapLocation_DESC_Left: Left: Frees up the right side of the screen for custom overlay elements.
General.OPTION_MinimapLocation_DESC_LeftConsole: Left: Frees up the right side of the screen.
General.OPTION_BattleCamera_DESC: Enable or disable camera movement during battle.
General.OPTION_BattleCamera_DESC_On: On: Camera moves dynamically during battle to focus on the action.
General.OPTION_BattleCamera_DESC_Off: Off: Camera remains still during battle.
General.OPTION_BattleFlashes_DESC: Enable or disable screen flashes during battle (for critical hits, etc.).
General.OPTION_BattleFlashes_DESC_On: On: Screen flashes will happen as normal during battle.
General.OPTION_BattleFlashes_DESC_Off: Off: Screen flashes will not happen during battle.
General.OPTION_TextureLoading_DESC: Choose when textures are loaded. Requires restart to take effect.
General.OPTION_RestrictInputDevices_DESC: Choose whether input will be recognized from all connected input devices or just one input device.
General.OPTION_RestrictInputDevices_DESC_On: On: Input will be recognized from all connected input devices.
General.OPTION_RestrictInputDevices_DESC_Off: Off: Input will only be recognized from the first detected input device.
General.OPTION_TextureLoading_DESC_OnDemand: On-Demand: Loads textures only as they are needed. Speeds up game startup.
General.OPTION_TextureLoading_DESC_Preload: Preload: Loads all textures at startup so that they are not loaded during gameplay. Can reduce stuttering.
General.OPTION_AudioEngine_DESC: Choose the audio playback engine. Only change this if you are experiencing audio problems. Requires restart to take effect.
General.OPTION_AudioEngine_DESC_FNA: FNA: Default. Keep using this if you are not experiencing audio problems.
General.OPTION_AudioEngine_DESC_NAudio: NAudio: Try using this if you are experiencing audio problems.
General.OPTION_NAudioLatency_DESC: Adjust audio latency for when Audio Engine is set to NAudio. Increasing can reduce crackling. Requires restart to take effect.
General.OPTION_NAudioLatency_DESC_Low: Low: Lowest latency, highest system requirements.
General.OPTION_NAudioLatency_DESC_Medium: Medium: Balanced latency and system requirements.
General.OPTION_NAudioLatency_DESC_High: High: Highest latency, lowest system requirements.
General.OPTION_DESC_PATCH_None: Standard: No special mode is enabled. Gameplay balance remains unadjusted.
General.OPTION_DESC_PATCH_Vanilla: Vanilla: Reverts all balance-related gameplay adjustments from patches back to the initial version of Crystal Project.
General.OPTION_DESC_PATCH_Chaos:
Chaos: The land of Sequoia is unfair. Victory is impossible, but how far can you get?
The following Assist Options are prohibited:
- Max Level Up
- Custom Difficulty
- Limitless Equipment
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_POPUP_WARNING:
The following options can make certain aspects of Crystal Project easier or less time consuming. You are encouraged to give the game a try before enabling any of these options, but if something is not for you, that's OK. Please feel free to make adjustments.
Once an option is turned on, it cannot be turned back off.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_MultiHomePoint: Enables setting up to 3 different @V.HomePoints at a time. Earlier parts of the game can often involve a lot of backtracking. Most players may want to enable this option.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_InnHomePoint: Enables free, automatic full recovery for the party when interacting with a @V.HomePoint.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_MaxLevelUp: Increases the party's maximum level, enabling further grinding to reduce difficulty. The maximum level is configurable.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_EasierNonBosse: Decreases the difficulty of non-boss enemies down to one difficulty below the current active difficulty. Bosses are unaffected.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_CustomDifficul: Enables freely adjusting the difficulty either up or down.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_SkipMinigames: Enables the option to skip minigames and obtain an automatic placement.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_EasyTimers: Adds more time to timers which sometimes show up while solving puzzles.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_BoostExp: Increases the amount of @V.Exp earned after battle. The exact percentage is configurable.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_BoostJxp: Increases the amount of @V.Jxp earned after battle. The exact percentage is configurable.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_BoostCurrency: Increases the amount of @V.Currency earned after battle. The exact percentage is configurable.
General.OPTION_DESC_ASSIST_OPTION_LimitlessEquip: Enables acquiring multiple copies of equipment that is normally limited in capacity.
General.OPTION_DESC_CHALLENGE_OPTION_POPUP_WARNI:
Challenge Options are not recommended for new players.
Are you sure you want to view Challenge Options?
General.OPTION_DESC_CHALLENGE_OPTION_MemberLimit: Decreases the number of party members.
General.OPTION_DESC_CHALLENGE_OPTION_HardcoreMod: Defeat means the end of adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_CHALLENGE_OPTION_LessExp: Decreases the amount of @V.Exp earned after battle. The exact percentage is configurable.
General.OPTION_DESC_CHALLENGE_OPTION_LessJxp: Decreases the amount of @V.Jxp earned after battle. The exact percentage is configurable.
General.OPTION_DESC_CHALLENGE_OPTION_LessCurrenc: Decreases the amount of @V.Currency earned after battle. The exact percentage is configurable.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Crystals: Randomizes Crystal locations and the initial six @V.Jobs.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Monsters_O: Off: Non-boss @V.Flame encounters will not be randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Monsters_S: Scaled: Non-boss @V.Flame encounters will be randomized with other non-boss @V.Flame encounters of similar power.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Monsters_F: Full: Non-boss @V.Flame encounters will be completely randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Bosses_Off: Off: Boss encounters will not be randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Bosses_Sca: Scaled: Boss encounters will be randomized with other boss encounters of similar power.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Bosses_Ful: Full: Boss encounters will be completely randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Items_Off: Off: Item locations will not be randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Items_Scal: Scaled: Items will be randomized with other items of similar power or importance.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Items_Full: Full: Item locations will be completely randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_IncludeRec: Includes basic/recovery items (eg, Potions, Ethers, Scrolls) in randomized item locations.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_IncludeQue: Includes quest-related items (eg, Black Squirrels, Dog Bones, Lost Penguins) in randomized item locations.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_IncludePro: Includes @V.Tools and progression-related @V.Artifacts in randomized item locations.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Equipment_: Off: Equipment locations will not be randomized.
Scaled: Equipment will be randomized with other equipment of similar power.
Full: Equipment locations will be completely randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_JobAbiliti: Randomizes which abilities can be learned by which @V.Jobs except for Monster Magic and Summon Magic.
Off: Abilities will not be randomized.
On: Abilities will be randomized only to @V.Jobs that are capable of using them.
Free: Abilities will be completely randomized and ability weapon restrictions will be removed.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_IncludeSch: Includes Monster Magic in randomized @V.Job abilities.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_IncludeSum: Includes Summon Magic in randomized @V.Job abilities.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_MonsterAbi: Randomizes which abilities can be used by which enemies.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_MonsterDif: Randomizes the difficulty of each individual enemy.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Passives: Randomizes which passive abilities can be learned by which @V.Jobs.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_InnatePass: Randomizes which innate passive abilities are attached to which @V.Jobs.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_TeleportPo: Randomizes the spawn point and teleport locations.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Progressio:
Castle Sequoia cannot be accessed until all Crystals have been discovered.
The location of the New World Stone will not be randomized.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_StartWithH: Begins the adventure with a Home Point Stone already in your inventory.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_StartWithT: Begins the adventure with the Treasure Finder already in your inventory.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_StartWithA: Begins the adventure with all maps already in your inventory.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_EnableSpoi: Enables access to the Spoiler Log to see where @V.Tools and progression-related @V.Artifacts have been randomized to.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_Seed:
Choose the randomizer seed.
Using the same seed will result in the same random output.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_CopyToClip: Copies current randomizer options to the clipboard.
General.OPTION_DESC_RANDOMIZER_OPTION_PasteFromC: Applies randomizer options from the clipboard.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepCrystals: Carry over discovered Crystals to the new adventure and unlock their associated @V.Jobs.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepLevels: Carry over accumulated @V.Exp and levels to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepAbilities: Carry over unlocked @V.Job abilities and accumulated @V.Jxp to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepCurrency: Carry over accumulated @V.Currency to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepEquipment:
Carry over acquired equipment to the new adventure.
Note: Equipment that is normally limited in capacity will remain limited.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_LimitlessEquip:
Enables acquiring multiple copies of equipment that is normally limited in capacity.
Note: This is an Assist Option.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepConsumable: Carry over acquired @V.Consumables to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepInstrument: Carry over acquired musical instruments to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepTeleportSt: Carry over acquired teleportation stones to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepPouches: Carry over acquired pouches to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepMaps: Carry over acquired maps to the new adventure. Does not include revealed map data.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepMapRevealD: Carry over revealed map data to the new adventure. Maps will need to be re-acquired before revealed map data will be viewable.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepMyQuintars: Carry over Quintar and Quintar Eggs currently in the Quintar Hatchery to the new adventure's Quintar Hatchery.
General.OPTION_DESC_NEW_GAME_PLUS_KeepArchive: Carry over unlocked @V.Atlas entries to the new adventure.
General.OPTION_FullScreen_DESC: Toggle between Full Screen and Window mode.
General.OPTION_Resolution_DESC: Set the current Full Screen or Window resolution.
General.OPTION_AspectRatio_DESC: Enable or disable letterbox / pillarbox. Only affects Full Screen.
General.OPTION_AspectRatio_DESC_Fixed: Fixed: Stretches content to fill the screen regardless of the current resolution's aspect ratio.
General.OPTION_AspectRatio_DESC_Dynamic: Dynamic: Adds a letterbox / pillarbox when necessary to maintain the content's 16:9 aspect ratio in the current resolution.
General.OPTION_Preset_DESC: Adjust advanced graphic options to specific quality presets.
General.OPTION_Preset_DESC_Low: Low: Optimizes performance at the cost of detail.
General.OPTION_Preset_DESC_High: High: Optimizes detail at the cost of performance.
General.OPTION_Graphics_DESC_Low: Simple: The environment appears clean and simple.
General.OPTION_Graphics_DESC_Medium: Detailed: The environment appears detailed at the cost of game performance.
General.OPTION_FrameRate_DESC: Adjust how the maximum FPS is determined.
General.OPTION_FrameRate_DESC_Fixed: Fixed: Renders frames according to the selected FPS.
General.OPTION_FrameRate_DESC_Display: Display: Renders frames to match the display's current refresh rate.
General.OPTION_Fps_DESC: Set the maximum FPS. Only takes effect when Frame Rate is set to Fixed.
General.OPTION_VSync_DESC: Enable or disable vertical synchronization. Only affects Full Screen.
General.OPTION_VSync_DESC_Off: Off: Helps reduce jitter when the framerate is less than 60 FPS.
General.OPTION_DrawDistance_DESC: Adjust the maximum draw distance. Usually only matters in scenes with large vistas.
General.OPTION_DrawDistance_DESC_Normal: Normal: Full draw distance. High performance impact.
General.OPTION_DrawDistance_DESC_Short: Short: Reduced draw distance. Helps a lot with performance.
General.OPTION_AntiAliasing_DESC_FXAA: FXAA: Simple anti-aliasing. Low performance impact.
General.OPTION_AntiAliasing_DESC_SSAA: SSAA: High-quality anti-aliasing. High performance impact.
General.OPTION_AntiAliasing_DESC_Both: Both: Mixes both. Highest performance impact.
General.OPTION_Shadows_DESC: Set the quality of dynamic shadows. The higher the quality, the greater the performance impact.
General.OPTION_EdgeOutlines_DESC_On: On: Outlines voxel edges. Can help make platforming easier. Medium performance impact.
General.OPTION_SSAO_DESC: Enable or disable screen space ambient occlusion.
General.OPTION_SSAO_DESC_On: On: Adds shadows to small crevices. Medium performance impact.
General.OPTION_TerrainAnimation_DESC_On: On: Water waves move in the wind and bushes move when touched. Low performance impact.
General.OPTION_DepthOfField_DESC: Enable or disable Depth of Field.
General.OPTION_DepthOfField_DESC_On: On: Object close to the camera and objects very far from the camera are blurred. Low performance impact.
General.OPTION_Bloom_DESC_On: On: Produces fringes of light extending from the borders of bright areas in the scene. Medium performance impact.
General.OPTION_DiffuseLighting_DESC_On: On: Brightness of surfaces depend on their facing relative to sunlight. Very low performance impact.
General.OPTION_LightCorrection_DESC_On: On: Overall brightness of the scene is increased when in dark scenes and is decreased when in bright scenes. Very low performance impact.
General.OPTION_WeatherParticles_DESC_On: On: Enables rain, snow, and so on. Very low performance impact.
General.OPTION_WeatherHaze_DESC_On: On: Enables atmospheric haze in certain regions. Low performance impact.
General.OPTION_WeatherHaze_DESC_Off: Off: Disabled. Can help with motion sickness. Improves performance.
General.OPTION_WeatherHaze_DESC_OnOption: On: Enables atmospheric haze in certain regions.
General.OPTION_WeatherHaze_DESC_OffOption: Off: Disabled. Can help with motion sickness.
General.OPTION_TerrainParticles_DESC_On: On: Enables particles which emit from the environment when certain terrain is touched. Almost no performance impact.
General.OPTION_FastShaderTechniques_DESC: Adjust how interior geometry is revealed.
General.OPTION_FastShaderTechniques_DESC_On: Simple: Geometry is revealed using a simple style. Improves performance.
General.OPTION_FastShaderTechniques_DESC_Off: Detailed: Geometry is revealed using a detailed style. Medium performance impact.
General.OPTION_PerChunkIndoorMask_DESC: Adjust how geometry is rendered at the far clip plane.
General.OPTION_PerChunkIndoorMask_DESC_On: Accurate: Fixes most distance-related rendering imperfections. Terrain is slower to load.
General.OPTION_PerChunkIndoorMask_DESC_Off: Legacy: Can help prevent pop-in. Terrain is faster to load.
General.OPTION_PerformanceMode_DESC_On: Enabled: Certain graphic settings are reduced while at specific locations to help improve performance (eg, polygon count, particle count, draw distance, shadow quality).
General.OPTION_PerformanceMode_DESC_Off: Disabled: Graphic settings are left unchanged.
